name: terminal-first
$comment: first is sugar over take(1): the same index sort with LIMIT 1, but shaped as QueryResult::Doc(Some) — serialized (untagged enum) as the SINGLE DOC OBJECT, not a one-element array (execute_collect_terminal terminal == "first" branch). Doc(None) would serialize as null. first composes with order/index (FIRST_INCOMPATIBLES only rejects take/unique/distinct/aggregate).
